blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Glenayre. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Glenayre, Port Moody: 10 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 8 of 11 Port Moody communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Glenayre rose from 5 in June to 10 in September (+100.0%), and 3 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.4% of Port Moody’s 135 houses listed.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Glenayre?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Glenayre. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Glenayre a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Glenayre had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Glenayre from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Glenayre over those 4 months, out of 51 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Glenayre?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
